name: Beastopia: Raiders
storyline:
In Beastopia, the animals that survived the apocalypse learned a few useful tricks: how to carry a gun, fix a machine, build a shelter and get out before somebody takes everything.

Venture into the ruins, search abandoned streets and dangerous laboratories, collect supplies, and make it back to your shelter with your loot.

But the old world is not empty. Stalkers roam the ruins. Hostile creatures guard valuable supplies. And other raiders are chasing the same prize.
summary: Beastopia: Raiders is a 2D PvPvE animal extraction shooter set after humanity’s extinction. Venture into ruined cities and dangerous laboratories, search for valuable supplies, and return safely to your shelter with your loot.
